summary: Khunpon Martial Arts is a Muay Thai, BJJ, MMA and Hyrox gym in Cherngtalay, Phuket, selling class passes and open gym access.

facts.label: Single class
facts.value: 450 baht for one class, valid 1 day

facts.label: Open gym, 1 month
facts.value: 2,500 baht for one month of facility access

facts.label: Opening
facts.value: Classes run seven days a week, gym open 08:00 to 20:00
facts.quote: Classes run seven days a week, and the gym is open from 08:00 to 20:00.

facts.label: Coaches
facts.quote: Fourteen coaches in three teams: BJJ and MMA, Muay Thai, and Fitness.
